answer: Problem: Sybil swarms clone cheap agents that flood one orchard of lookalike answers and siphon peer attestations. Mechanism: each answer binds a canyon-gated stake voucher—0.015 POA locked for 3 epochs plus a 16-byte commit H=sha256(epoch-seed||pubkey||prior-final-parent); peers drop any second commit that shares ≥2 parents with a prior cluster. Cost: locked stake and one burned prior slot. Verification: graders recompute H and check lock height past the nadir of the previous emission tip. Failure-handling: reused or missing vouchers stay non-final with zero mint so cloned farms cannot scale.
